found.why: Reads David's five 'ברכי נפשי' as the five parts of the soul, nefesh to yechidah, and ties them to BR 14's 'five names', which is Rav Tzadok's opening equation; it then turns to five corresponding impurities.

found.ref: Yakar MiPaz, Insights on Haftarah, Vayishlach 2
found.why: The five levels come in stages through life (ruach at thirteen, then neshamah, chayah, yechidah), and nefesh-ruach-neshamah-chayah correspond to the letters of Havayah and yechidah to the tip of the Yud: both the mapping and the staged-life reading of this os.
Zaken = acquired wisdom, and 'ba ba-yamim' = entering the inner light of the days, the first-day light hidden for the righteous: the same pairing of zaken with the hidden light and the supernal days.

The upper worlds are called 'days'; Abraham 'zaken' acquired wisdom and 'ba ba-yamim' reached the upper worlds: the same reading as Rav Tzadok's ביומין עלאין, without his refinement of the attributes.

footnotes.text: **Be'er Mayim Chaim, Bereishis 2:7** (Chassidus) — R. Chaim of Chernovitz also reads David's five "ברכי נפשי" as the five parts of the soul named in Bereishis Rabbah 14, nefesh through yechidah, the same equation with which Rav Tzadok opens. ונראה דהכתוב רומז בזה לחמשה חלקי הנשמה שניתן באדם שכנגדם אמר דוד חמשה פעמים ברכי נפשי הנקראים בפי חכמי אמת נפש רוח נשמה חיה יחידה

footnotes.ref: Yakar MiPaz, Insights on Haftarah, Vayishlach 2
footnotes.text: **Yakar MiPaz, Haftarah Vayishlach 2** (Chassidus) — Gives the same mapping, nefesh to chayah on the four letters of Havayah and yechidah on the tip of the Yud. It also has the levels arrive in stages through life, ruach at thirteen and the higher levels through service, as Rav Tzadok reads the five clauses of Berachos 10a as stages of a person's life. ונפש רוח ונשמה חי' הם נגד הוה"י ויחידה הוא נגד הקוץ של יוד

**Sefas Emes, Chayei Sarah (31:3)** (Chassidus) — Reads *zaken* as acquired wisdom and *ba ba-yamim* as entering the inner light of the days, the first-day light hidden for the righteous. Rav Tzadok makes the same pairing of *zaken*, the hidden light of "יהי אור" and the supernal days. ופי' בא בימים בפנימיות הימים דכתיב ויקרא אלקים לאור יום. א"כ כל יום יש בו אור. אבל גנזו לצדיקים

**Noam Elimelech, Vayera (1:1)** (Chassidus) — "Days" are the upper worlds: Abraham, *zaken* through acquired wisdom, "came into days" by reaching them in his holiness. This is the same reading as Rav Tzadok's "ביומין עלאין." דהנה העולמות העליונים נקראים 'ימים', והצדיק בקדושתו מגיע עד העולמות העליונים
